title: Insight view/edit mode: computed in insightSceneLogic, propagated via readOnly/editMode props
answers: Where is insight edit vs view mode computed?
How does insightMode reach InsightViz and Query?
body:
- Computed: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightSceneLogic.tsx `urlToAction` (~L833): `mode==='edit' || shortId==='new'` → ItemMode.Edit; subscriptions/alerts/sharing → own modes; else View. Stored in `insightMode` reducer, set by `setSceneState`. Not derived from permissions.
- Scene consumers: InsightAsScene.tsx (passes `readOnly={insightMode !== Edit}` and `editMode` to `<Query>`, gates showQueryEditor/help), InsightPageHeader.tsx (forceEdit, saveOnBlur, Edit vs Save/Cancel), InsightSceneHeader.tsx, InsightScene.tsx (SQL editor redirect), InsightModals.tsx (`isOpen={insightMode===...}`), SidePanel/InsightPanelToggles.tsx + InsightSceneMenuBar.tsx (`hasDashboardItemId && insightMode !== Edit`), SqlInsightFilters.tsx (View only).
- Below scene: Query.tsx `readOnly` picks propsQuery over localQuery (~L106); InsightViz.tsx `showing={!readOnly && showingFilters}` for EditorFilters, `showingFilters = query.showFilters ?? editMode ?? false`; InsightVizDisplay.tsx `actionable = !embedded && editMode`, `canEditSeriesNameInline`; InsightsTable `useURLForSorting={!editMode}`.
says: How does the insight editor determine when to show view versus edit mode?
Which components know whether an insight is being edited or just viewed?
Where is read-only versus editable state computed for an insight display?
What controls whether an insight is in view mode or edit mode?
How does edit mode information get passed to child visualization components?
search: Insight view/edit mode is computed in insightSceneLogic.urlToAction (~L833) based on URL mode==='edit', shortId==='new', or feature-specific modes (subscriptions/alerts/sharing); otherwise defaults to View mode, stored in insightMode reducer. This mode is NOT derived from permissions. It propagates via readOnly={insightMode !== Edit} and editMode props to Query, InsightViz, InsightPageHeader, and other consumers that gate showQueryEditor, inline editing, and Save/Cancel buttons. Applies to implementing view/edit UI toggling, feature gating, and mode-dependent rendering throughout insight scenes and components.
